nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances of SAFEDOGE contract.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding ERC20 spending allowances.
Public address used as the bot/blacklist target address checked inside _transfer.
Public address used as the sender-exempt blacklist address checked inside _transfer.
Private total supply variable, initialized to 100 * 10**9 * 10**18 and mutable via setFeeTotal.
Public uint256 cap (default 50,000,000e18) enforced against transfers to _tBotAddress.
Private owner address from Ownable, used by onlyOwner access-control modifier.
SAFEDOGE constructor: mints _tTotal to _msgSender() and sets Ownable owner.
ERC20 transfer(address recipient,uint256 amount) forwarding to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
ERC20 transferFrom(sender,recipient,amount): moves tokens then deducts allowance from _msgSender().
ERC20 approve(spender,amount) forwarding to _approve with _msgSender() as owner.
Private allowance writer that validates non-zero addresses and writes _allowances.
Internal transfer routine: blacklist/max amount check plus SafeMath balance updates and Transfer event.
onlyOwner function that mints 'amount' new tokens to _msgSender() by increasing _tTotal and _balances.
onlyOwner overload Approve(address blackListAddress) that overwrites _tBotAddress.
onlyOwner overload Approve(uint256 maxTxBlackPercent) that overwrites _maxBlack.
onlyOwner function that overwrites _tBlackAddress.
View returning _balances[account].
View returning _tTotal.
View returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Overridden Ownable owner() that always returns address(0), masking the real owner.
onlyOwner function that emits OwnershipTransferred but never clears _owner.
onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner to newOwner after a zero-address check.
Caller-controlled address obtained through _msgSender(); governs ownership checks, allowance spending and token receipt.
Unbounded token mint: setFeeTotal adds to _tTotal and credits _msgSender()'s balance, silently inflating supply.
Balance arithmetic in _transfer: _balances[sender].sub(amount) then _balances[recipient].add(amount) with state written after the blacklist branch.
Allowance arithmetic in transferFrom: _allowances[sender][_msgSender()].sub(amount) executed after the balance movement.

edges.reason: recipient parameter is forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
amount parameter of transfer is consumed by the transfer routine.
sender parameter of transferFrom reaches _transfer as the debited account.
recipient parameter of transferFrom reaches _transfer as the credited account.
amount parameter of transferFrom drives both balance and allowance updates.
spender parameter of approve flows into _approve.
amount parameter of approve is stored in _allowances.
owner-supplied blackListAddress is written into the privileged _tBotAddress state variable.
maxTxBlackPercent is multiplied by 10**18 and stored in _maxBlack, altering transfer limits.
amount parameter feeds the unbounded _tTotal.add(amount) mint operation.
newOwner parameter replaces the privileged _owner address.
blackAddress parameter rewrites the _tBlackAddress transfer-exemption state variable.
account parameter indexes the _balances mapping read.
constructor assigns the local msgSender into _owner.
msg.sender is passed as sender when transfer() invokes _transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner debited inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared against _owner by onlyOwner and also receives the minted tokens.
msg.sender must equal _owner to overwrite _tBotAddress.
msg.sender must equal _owner to overwrite _maxBlack.
msg.sender must equal _owner to overwrite _tBlackAddress.
msg.sender's balance is credited by the unrestricted mint in setFeeTotal.
msg.sender must equal _owner before ownership can be transferred.
transfer delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine before touching allowances.
approve delegates execution to the private _approve routine.
setFeeTotal is the only execution path reaching the unbounded mint operation.
transferOwnership branch rewrites the _owner state variable used by onlyOwner.
_transfer reads and writes _balances with SafeMath sub/add, the core balance mutation path.
_transfer reads _tBotAddress to decide whether the _maxBlack limit applies to the recipient.
_transfer reads _tBlackAddress to exempt the sender from the max amount check.
Approve(address) assigns the owner-controlled value into _tBotAddress, controlling future transfer gating.
setBlackAddress assigns into _tBlackAddress, toggling the transfer-limit exemption.
_approve writes the granted value into the _allowances mapping.
Balance subtraction/addition operation mutates the _balances mapping.
Allowance subtraction mutates the _allowances mapping after the transfer.
Mint operation increments _tTotal, permanently inflating total supply.
setFeeTotal is the only writer that increases _tTotal after deployment.
Approve(uint256) recomputes _maxBlack from an owner-supplied percentage.
_transfer compares the transfer amount against _maxBlack.
balanceOf reads from the _balances mapping.
totalSupply returns _tTotal.
allowance reads from the _allowances mapping.
Constructor mints the initial _tTotal into the deployer's _balances entry.

normalization_plan.reason: Local parameter recipient exists only to feed the transfer routine and should be folded into its enclosing function node.
Local parameter amount exists only to feed the transfer routine and should be folded into its enclosing function node.
Sender parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom and should be merged into that core function node.
Recipient parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom and should be merged into that core function node.
Amount parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom and should be merged into that core function node.
Spender parameter has no independent semantics outside approve and should be folded into it.
Amount parameter has no independent semantics outside approve and should be folded into it.
Parameter only serves as the value written into _tBotAddress and should be merged into the overload it belongs to.
Parameter only serves to recompute _maxBlack and should be merged into the overload it belongs to.
Mint amount parameter should be merged into the unsafe mint operation it directly drives.
newOwner parameter only exists to reassign _owner and should be folded into transferOwnership.
blackAddress parameter only writes _tBlackAddress and should be folded into setBlackAddress.
Account parameter is a trivial read index and should be folded into balanceOf.
Local msgSender holder only exists inside the constructor and should be merged into the constructor node.
